h1: Custom Small Workwear for Your Team
metaDescription: Order custom small workwear for your team. Shirts, vests, and more in size small. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When ordering workwear for your team, size small is essential for employees who need a trimmer fit without extra fabric. From safety tees to hi-vis jackets, small sizes ensure comfort and safety without bunching or loose sleeves. Perfect for warehouse staff, field crews, or anyone who prefers a closer cut. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom small workwear including a safety tee and hi-vis vest in size small for team uniforms.
